# LAME 3.100 (MP3 encoder)

Used by Sessions to export recordings as MP3. Unmodified LAME 3.100, built
as a static library for Apple Silicon with `build.sh` (encoder only).

LAME is licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License (see
[COPYING](COPYING)); it is compatible with Spindle's GPL-3.0-or-later.
Source: https://lame.sourceforge.io
